patches.summary: feat(bloomest-laundry-manager): add 7 interfaces / 15 methods (reboot.cashbox, research.log-search, account.change-password, tickets.list, messages.send, statistics.* x9, actions.query)
findings_addressed: F-reboot: POST /reboot?laundry=<id> not exposed (was promoted flat shortcut without --yes/--dry-run gate)
F-research: POST /research not exposed at all
F-account: PUT /profile?username=&change=<SHA1> not exposed; F11 security warning required
F-tickets: GET /tickets?laundry=<id> not exposed (was promoted flat shortcut)
F-messages: POST /messages (single-user email) not exposed with structured flags

F-statistics: 9 discriminator-based reports (corrispettivo, all_movements, card-report, cycles_report, laundry_summaries, sales_by_device, summaries_by_currency, summaries_hopper_currency, alarms) not exposed individually
F-actions: PUT /actions (PUT-as-query quirk) not exposed with date-filter flags
patches.notes: Six existing promoted_*.go shortcut commands de-registered in root.go to avoid Cobra name collision with the new full-interface roots. The promoted source files themselves are intoccati. Three non-colliding promoted entries (lockers, *-profile, *-version) stay registered. Refactor B (post-checkpoint-2): extracted runStatisticsReport + normalizeISODate into internal/cli/statistics_helper.go so all 9 statistics_*.go method files are now thin (~30 LOC each, identical shape).
